theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_bh_l1loc_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (Fs : ℕ → Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (F₀ : Set (Euclid (m + 1))), (∀ k, MeasurableSet (Fs k)) → MeasurableSet F₀ → (∀ R : ℝ, Tendsto (fun k => volume (symmDiff (Fs k) F₀ ∩ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) R)) atTop (𝓝 0)) → (∀ f : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ z in Fs k, f z) atTop (𝓝 (∫ z in F₀, f z))) ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, Tendsto (fun k => volume (Fs k ∩ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s)) atTop (𝓝 (volume (F₀ ∩ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s)))) ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, Tendsto (fun k => volume (ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s \ Fs k)) atTop (𝓝 (volume (ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) s \ F₀)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
